message: Session cookie issued without the Secure flag
fix: Set Secure: true so the cookie only travels over HTTPS

message: Cookie issued with HttpOnly disabled (JS can read it)
fix: Set HttpOnly: true on session cookies

message: CORS CheckOrigin always returns true (any origin allowed)
fix: Compare r.Host against an allowlist of origins

message: net/http/pprof imported (debug endpoints on default mux)
fix: Remove the import or register pprof only on a protected admin server

message: Untrusted request data written straight to logs (log injection)
fix: Sanitize or structure-log the value instead of interpolating raw input

message: Password hashed with plain SHA-256 (fast hash)
fix: Use bcrypt, scrypt, or argon2id for password storage

message: File created from user-controlled path (path traversal)
fix: Resolve the path under a fixed root and reject traversal

message: CORS configured to allow every origin
fix: List the exact origins that may call this API

message: filepath.Join appends a user-controlled component (path traversal)
fix: Reject '..' components and verify the joined path stays under the root

message: GORM Raw() builds SQL by formatting or concatenation (injection)
fix: Pass placeholders and args: db.Raw("... WHERE id = ?", id)

message: jwt.Parse called with nil key function (signature never verified)
fix: Provide a keyfunc that validates the algorithm and key

message: http.ServeFile path derived from the request URL (path traversal)
fix: Clean and confine the path under the document root first
Use ssh.FixedHostKey or a known_hosts callback

message: AES key is a hard-coded string literal
fix: Load the key from a KMS or secret manager at runtime
